item.title: Building Pi with Pi
item.description:
📝 A bad issue that contains a plausible but wrong diagnosis creates extra work. The most frustrating failure mode right now is that people submit issues that are not in their own voice. It is also frustrating because when I give that issue to Pi, Pi sees the wrong diagnosis too.
🔗 Read more: https://lucumr.pocoo.org/2026/5/24/pi-oss/
